english:
See in the First Volume up to the fourth
Sunday, keeping the order of the place.

September

6. Sunday, Tone 1 [AJ / AJz]. Fourth. Eve of the Fast of the Holy Cross. Father [Harts] Tone 6 [Gk], 15: "Ineffable Nature" (Anchareli bnutyun). Dismissal Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 1 [Adz]: "With the Women" (End kanaysn).
17. Monday, Tone 2 [AK]. Fast of the Holy Cross. Father [Harts], 16, Tone 7 [Dz]: "Glorified is Thy name forever."
8. Tuesday, Tone 3 [BDz]. Feast of the Nativity of the Holy Mother of God from Anna.
13. Sunday, Tone 8 [DK]. Exaltation of the Holy Cross. See in the First Volume up to the tenth Sunday, keeping the order of the place.
20. Sunday, Tone 7 [Dz]. Second [Sunday after Cross]. Dismissal Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 7 [Dz]: "Awesome" (Ahagin).
21. Monday, Tone 8 [DK]. Fast of the Varag Holy Cross. [Commemoration of] Mamas, etc. Father [Harts] Tone 7 [Dz]: "Without malice" (Anokhakal).
23. Wednesday, Tone 2 [AK]. Father [Harts] Tone 7 [Dz]: "God of our fathers."
24. Sunday, Tone 6 [GK]. Third. Feast of the Varag Holy Cross. The leisure period [between feasts] is seven weeks.

October

4. Sunday, Tone 5 [GDz]. Fourth. Dismissal Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 5 [Gdz]: "By the sign of the Cross" (I khachanishn).
11. Sunday, Tone 4 [BK]. Fifth. Dismissal Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 4 [Bk]: "Christ is risen," and Morning [Hymn].
18. Sunday, Tone 3 [BDz]. Sixth. Dismissal Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 3 [Bdz]: "At the tomb" (I gerezman), and "They came to the tomb" (Ekin i gerezman), and "The voice of good tidings" (Dzayn avetavor).
25. Sunday, Tone 2 [AK]. Seventh. Feast of the Discovery of the Cross.
27. Tuesday, Tone 4 [BK]. [Commemoration of the] Saints of Hypermachius, and of Severianus of Sebaste, etc. Father [Harts] Tone 7 [Dz]: "Thou who art exalted."
28. Wednesday, Tone 5 [GDz]. Father [Harts] Tone 6 [Gk]: "God of our fathers Who saved."
31. Saturday, Tone 8 [DK]. All Saints: ancient and new, known and unknown.
See these and all the remaining ones in the First Volume unto the end, keeping the order of the place.

November

Sunday, Tone 1 [AJ / AJz]. Eighth. Dismissal Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 1 [Adz]: "Who is ineffable" (Or anchar).
Sunday, Tone 8 [DK]. Ninth. Dismissal Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 8 [Dk]: "Of the angels" (Hreshtakatsn), and "Thy angel, Lord" (Hreshtak ko Ter).
Sunday, Tone 7 [Dz]. Tenth. Eve of the Fast of the Advent [Yisnak]. Dismissal Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 5 [Gdz]: "Who art above" (Or i verd es) to the end.
Monday, Tone 8 [DK]. Fast of Advent. Father [Harts] Tone 7 [Dz]: "Who in everything didst show."
Saturday, Tone 5 [GDz]. Feast of the Presentation of the Holy Mother of God of three years [into the Temple].
Sunday, Tone 6 [GK]. First [Sunday of Advent]. Father [Harts] Tone 1 [A]: "Blessed art Thou, Lord God." Dismissal Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 6 [Gk]: "Thy resurrection" (Zko yarutyund), and "Taking" (Areal), and "And our" (Ev mer).
Monday, Tone 7 [Dz]. [Commemoration of] Julian and Vasilouhi. Father [Harts] Tone 7 [Dz]: "Those who hoped."
Sunday, Tone 5 [GDz]. Second. Father [Harts] Tone 2 [Ak]: "Unoriginate Word" (Anskizbn band). Dismissal Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 5 [Gdz]: "Glorified is Thy resurrection."

December

Wednesday, Tone 8 [DK]. Father [Harts] of the Fast Tone 8 [Dk]: "Blessed art Thou, Lord God of our fathers."
Saturday, Tone 3 [BDz]. [Commemoration of] Nicholas and Gregory, the wonderworking Patriarchs, and the other Nicholas the Patriarch and Myron the Bishop.
Sunday, Tone 4 [BK]. Third. Eve of the Fast of Saint James [Hakob]. Father [Harts] Tone 3 [B]: "Who art the King." Dismissal Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 4 [Bk]: "The women forestalled" (Kankhetsin kanaykn).
Wednesday, Tone 7 [Dz]. Fast. Feast of the Conception of the Holy Virgin from Anna.
Sunday, Tone 3 [BDz]. Fourth. Father [Harts] Tone 4 [Bk]: "Who [the form of] a servant." Dismissal Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 3 [Bdz]: "Today they rejoiced" (Aysor zuarchatsan).
Sunday, Tone 2 [AK]. Fifth. Father [Harts] Tone 5 [Gdz]: "Who from eternity." Dismissal Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 2 [Ak]: "Risen" (Yarutsyal), and "Wonderful" (Skancheli), and "Wondrous" (Hrashali).
Monday, Tone 3 [BDz]. [Commemoration of] Abraham and Khoren, etc. Father [Harts] Tone 2 [Ak]: "Who art exalted."
Tuesday, Tone 4 [BK]. [Commemoration of] Theodore [Astvadsatur] the Witness. Father [Harts] Tone 3 [Bdz]: "Without malice" (Anokhakal).
Wednesday, Tone 5 [GDz]. Father [Harts] Tone 8 [Dk]: "Blessed is the Lord God, blessed."
